mapper.insert:
insert into roam_member_fog_cell (member_id, cell_key, cell_prefix5, first_revealed_at, last_revealed_at) values
(#{memberId}, #{c}, left(#{c}, 5), #{at}, #{at})
on duplicate key update last_revealed_at = greatest(last_revealed_at, values(last_revealed_at))
mapper.select: select distinct f.geohash7 from roam_fog_tile f join roam_session s on s.id = f.session_id and s.member_id = f.member_id where f.member_id = #{memberId} and f.geohash7 is not null and (s.status = 0 or (s.status = 1 and s.finished_at > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day))) and left(f.geohash7, 5) in #{p} order by f.geohash7 limit #{limit}
